title: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Shortfall Charge at Premises Also Taking Small Business Electricity Supply
content:
**Pricing note.** In the correction of a Commercial Natural Gas Supply swing shortfall charge line, the shortfall charge per therm follows the business's electricity supply at the same premise:

- when the Beacon Ridge Small Business Electricity Supply agreement on that premise is active and the business's Small Business Electricity Supply energy charge lines whose billing period start is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the correction date sum to at least $15000.00, the charge is $0.0300 per therm;
- when that agreement is active and those lines sum to less, the charge is $0.0450 per therm;
- in every other case no electricity-linked charge applies, and the rate carried on the shortfall line stands.

The status comes from the Small Business Electricity Supply agreement record for the gas site's premise; the sum is the total amount of the business's Small Business Electricity Supply energy charge lines in the window.

## Charge by electricity holding

| Electricity agreement on the same premise | Electricity energy charges in the twelve-month window | Shortfall charge per therm |
|---|---|---|
| Active | $15000.00 or more | $0.0300 |
| Active | Less than $15000.00 | $0.0450 |
| Not active, or none on the premise | Any | No electricity-linked charge |

## Illustrations (hypothetical, correction dated 2025-10-05)

- A laundry's gas site has an active Small Business Electricity Supply agreement, and its electricity energy charge lines with billing period starts from 2024-10-06 onward total $18420.55: each correct shortfall therm is charged $0.0300.
- Another site's active electricity agreement shows energy charges of $14999.99 in the window: $0.0450 per therm.
- An electricity energy charge line whose billing period start is 2024-10-05 is outside the window and is not summed.
